components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-commitment submit action with a large bilingual touch target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 56px; padding: 14px 22px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--color-primary, #2363d1); color: var(--color-primary-contrast, #fff); box-shadow: 0 5px 14px var(--color-primary-shadow, rgba(35,99,209,.22)); font: 760 18px/1.35 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; transition: background .16s ease-out, transform .16s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-active, #194fae); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus, rgba(35,99,209,.16)), 0 5px 14px var(--color-primary-shadow, rgba(35,99,209,.22)); }

components.name: Task Card
components.description: Bordered operational panel for forms and dashboard sections.
components.html:
比赛信息 / Match details

填写场次和队号 / Enter match and team.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d8e0ea); border-radius: var(--radius-panel, 14px); background: var(--color-card-bg, #fff); color: var(--color-text, #132238); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel, 0 5px 18px rgba(24,43,69,.08)); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 9px; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card h3::after { content: ''; display: block; width: 42px; height: 2px; margin-top: 9px; background: var(--color-accent, #168fb1); } .ds-card p { margin: 14px 0 0; color: var(--color-text-muted, #5e7189); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Large bilingual entry field for rapid match data capture.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-label, #263b55); font: 630 18px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 52px; padding: 13px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #bdc9d8); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--color-input-bg, #f8fafc); color: var(--color-text, #132238); font-family: inherit; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.35; transition: border-color .16s ease-out, box-shadow .16s ease-out; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary, #2363d1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus, rgba(35,99,209,.16)); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-faint, #7e8da0); }

components.name: Selectable Chip
components.description: Compact multi-select note control with a clear selected state.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d8e0ea); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface-subtle, #f4f7fb); color: var(--color-text-muted, #5e7189); font: 400 16px/1.35 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; transition: background .16s ease-out, border-color .16s ease-out; } .ds-chip-active, .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary, #2363d1); background: var(--color-primary-soft, #e9f1ff); color: var(--color-primary, #2363d1); font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus, rgba(35,99,209,.16)); }

components.name: Scoring Counter
components.description: Single-row rapid scoring control with fixed −1, value, +1, +2, +4 order.
components.css: .ds-counter { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 7px; width: 100%; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-counter button, .ds-counter output { display: flex; min-width: 0; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); font-weight: 760; } .ds-counter button { border: 1px solid var(--color-primary, #2363d1); background: var(--color-primary-soft, #e9f1ff); color: var(--color-primary, #2363d1); transition: background .12s ease-out, transform .12s ease-out; } .ds-counter output { border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d8e0ea); background: var(--color-card-bg, #fff); color: var(--color-text, #132238); font-size: 22px; } .ds-counter button:hover { background: var(--color-primary, #2363d1); color: var(--color-primary-contrast, #fff); } .ds-counter button:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-counter button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus, rgba(35,99,209,.16)); }

components.name: Alliance Selector
components.description: Paired FTC alliance controls whose selected state uses semantic red or blue while retaining text labels.
components.css: .ds-alliance { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-alliance button { min-height: 50px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d8e0ea); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--color-surface-subtle, #f4f7fb); color: var(--color-text-muted, #5e7189); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.35; transition: background .16s ease-out, border-color .16s ease-out; } .ds-alliance-red.ds-selected { border-color: var(--color-alliance-red, #a93d49); background: var(--color-alliance-red, #a93d49); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; } .ds-alliance-blue.ds-selected { border-color: var(--color-alliance-blue, #245fbd); background: var(--color-alliance-blue, #245fbd); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; } .ds-alliance button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus, rgba(35,99,209,.16)); }

components.name: Event Context
components.description: Separates the remembered viewed event from the centrally active event with explicit bilingual labels.
components.html: 查看赛事 / Viewed eventSingapore Qualifier · 当前 / Active
components.css: .ds-event-context { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 4px 14px; align-items: center; padding: 18px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d8e0ea); border-radius: var(--radius-panel, 14px); background: var(--color-card-bg, #fff); color: var(--color-text, #132238); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel, 0 5px 18px rgba(24,43,69,.08)); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-event-context span { color: var(--color-text-muted, #5e7189); font-size: 16px; } .ds-event-context strong { grid-column: 1; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-event-context button { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary, #2363d1); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--color-primary-soft, #e9f1ff); color: var(--color-primary, #2363d1); font-weight: 700; } .ds-event-context button:hover { background: var(--color-primary, #2363d1); color: var(--color-primary-contrast, #fff); } .ds-event-context button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus, rgba(35,99,209,.16)); }

components.name: Sync Status
components.description: Bilingual synchronization state with color, text, and marker geometry.
components.html: 等待同步 / Waiting to sync
components.css: .ds-sync { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d8e0ea); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--color-surface-subtle, #f4f7fb); color: var(--color-text-muted, #5e7189); font: 400 16px/1.35 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-sync-mark { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex: 0 0 14px; border: 3px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-sync-queued { color: var(--color-warning, #986816); } .ds-sync-queued .ds-sync-mark { border-top-color: transparent; }

components.name: Sticky App Header
components.description: Centered bilingual navigation with balanced side actions.
components.html: 比赛侦察 / Match Scouting
components.css: .ds-header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(112px,1fr) minmax(0,2fr) minmax(112px,1fr); min-height: 64px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d8e0ea); background: var(--color-card-bg, #fff); color: var(--color-text, #132238); box-shadow: 0 3px 14px var(--color-shadow, rgba(24,43,69,.1)); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-header strong { text-align: center; font-size: 20px; } .ds-header button { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d8e0ea); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--color-surface-subtle, #f4f7fb); color: var(--color-primary, #2363d1); font-weight: 700; } .ds-header button:last-child { justify-self: end; } .ds-header button:hover { background: var(--color-primary-soft, #e9f1ff); } .ds-header button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus, rgba(35,99,209,.16)); }

narrative.overview: The shipped interface is a dense but calm engineering dashboard built for repeated use under match pressure. Its authority comes from semantic status, disciplined navy and blue surfaces, tabular numbers, crisp dividers, and a small set of cyan technical marks—not from ornamental science-fiction effects. Every operational label is designed to tolerate permanent Chinese/English display. A shared theme root carries font scaling and light/dark variables through both H5 and WeChat Mini Program component trees, while large inputs, direct actions, and compressed responsive grids preserve fast entry on either platform.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained navy, blue, silver-gray, and neutral surfaces with cyan reserved for technical accents.
Semantic light/dark theme slots rather than page-specific color choices.
Distinct active-event status and viewed-event selection, stated in text rather than inferred from color.
Bilingual, wrap-safe labels and numeric displays with tabular figures.
Bordered panels, compact structural rules, and low ambient elevation.
Direct touch controls optimized for repeated scouting actions.

rules.name: The Cyan Instrument Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks technical structure or status only; it never becomes the dominant action or decorative field.

rules.name: The Semantic Parity Rule
rules.body: New colors enter through reusable semantic light and dark roles; do not hard-code a one-theme-only surface.

rules.name: The Status Has Shape Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, error, and synchronization states pair color with text and a visible marker or border treatment.

rules.name: The Alliance Is Semantic Rule
rules.body: Red and blue identify FTC alliances only. Use the paired alliance tokens for selected controls and badges, with readable text labels retained.

rules.name: The Bilingual Integrity Rule
rules.body: Chinese and English remain together; labels wrap instead of truncating or shrinking into illegibility.

rules.name: The Numeric Readout Rule
rules.body: Counters, progress values, and team identifiers use tabular figures for stable scanning.

rules.name: The Six-Role Scale Rule
rules.body: Reuse display, headline, title, field, body, and compact variables before introducing a one-off size; local weight changes express emphasis without creating another role.

rules.name: The Reachable Control Rule
rules.body: Canonical interactive controls are at least 44px tall; primary submit controls are 56px and standard fields/counters are 52px.

rules.name: The Bordered Before Floating Rule
rules.body: Use a border and tonal separation first; reserve shadows for panels, sticky navigation, focus, and primary commitment actions.

rules.name: The Two-Tier Radius Rule
rules.body: New surfaces use the 14px panel or 10px control radius unless they are explicitly a compact badge, chip, or circular status mark.

dos: Do route new visual values through the existing semantic theme variables and preserve light/dark parity.
Do distinguish the central active event from a user's remembered viewed event with explicit bilingual context labels.
Do keep Chinese and English visible together and allow labels to wrap safely.
Do use the 14px panel, 10px control, 8px compact, and 999px chip roles intentionally.
Do preserve the single-row five-part scoring counter and minimum 44px canonical touch target.
Do use borders, short rules, tabular numbers, and status geometry for the subtle control-desk character.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass effects, neon glow, or ornamental science-fiction decoration.
Don't promote cyan into a dominant button, large background, or decorative field.
Don't introduce glyph icons, invented kickers, or a display typeface outside the shipped platform sans-serif system.
Don't rely on color alone for synchronization, validation, warning, or completion states.
Don't use alliance red or blue as generic status, decoration, or primary-action color.
Don't replace direct match-entry controls with hidden menus or multi-step interactions.
